task: SC-SUCC1-V2 Current PTR3 Successor Evidence Rebinding / Regeneration
operational_definition: The immutable historical R1-PTR3 successor remains ancestor evidence. A separately sealed current-runtime successor binds the authorized commit lineage, current production source bytes, current Build/Config/Runtime/Prompt/route identities, PTR9/PTR10/SC-IC1 evidence, and an exact offline PTR3 semantic revalidation receipt. The materializer validates both eras and never requires historical source bytes to equal current source bytes.
fail_closed_conditions: historical blob or report tree mismatch
missing, stale, altered, or unknown current successor
wrong branch or unapproved HEAD lineage
forbidden_narrowing: No rewrite of historical PTR3 evidence
No acceptance of stale or unknown successor profiles
No production source or BAML change
No Provider, network, model, paid call, Fresh packet, approval, or Canary execution
